item.title: Build With the Models Your Mac Already Has
item.description: My company’s official language is English, but we are in Tokyo, and plenty of discussions drift into Japanese. My colleagues are generous about it, and they help me learn. Still, we kept saying the same thing: we wish something translated English and Japanese in real time, without leaking anything.

item.title: Building a Local Document Reader with Streaming TTS
item.description: Ever wished you could just press play on a long document and have it read to you without uploading anything to the cloud? That’s exactly what this project does. Feed it text, and within milliseconds, you’re hearing it narrated. No waiting, no cloud APIs, just your machine doing the work.
